name: wrap
description: Put your design on anything: create a scene of any blank product or share a photo, turn it into a reusable mockup template, then place your designs on it and export the result.

interface.longDescription: Wrap turns photos into reusable mockup templates. Ask for a realistic scene of any blank product, or share your own photo, and Wrap converts it while you watch. Then add your designs, adjust how they sit on the product, and export the mockup as an image. Your mockups are saved in your Wrap account, so you can reopen them in later chats or on wrap.design.
defaultPrompt: Convert my image into a mockup template
Create a t-shirt scene for a mockup
